name: Capture Supabase row updates and record recovery receipts with HTTP Request

nodes.name: Read row
nodes.notes: Header Auth: apikey = a server-side Supabase sb_secret key. Keep this credential only in n8n. Secret keys bypass RLS; use the dedicated test project first.

nodes.name: Capture update
nodes.notes: Changes the configured row and returns actual snapshots atomically. Never retry this node or rerun the whole execution just because recording failed. Retry only the recording node with its saved payload.

nodes.name: Record operation
nodes.notes: Select Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_RECORDING_KEY. Retries reuse the captured payload. Do not rerun your original provider action to retry recording.

parameters.content:
### How it works
This example is for n8n builders who update Supabase rows and want to rehearse recovery on disposable data. A manual trigger reads one registered row, validates its revision, and calls the capture RPC. That transaction saves the original values before updating status and seats. HTTP Request nodes then deliver the confirmed before/after receipt to Rewind.

Recovery is a separate workflow. A person reviews and approves the recorded change in Rewind; the matching worker checks the current revision before restoring. Approval queues work. Verify the actual row in Supabase after the worker runs. A later edit must be preserved, not overwritten.

### Setup
Use a development Supabase project, n8n, and a Rewind account. From https://rewind.kanishq.dev/#connect download and run the connector SQL, then the disposable demo-table SQL. Set your project URL and matching connection name in Configure endpoints. Select Supabase apikey Header Auth on Read row and Capture update, and a Rewind recording credential on Record operation. No credentials are included.

Run once, approve in Rewind, then run its separate Supabase recovery template. Check active/5 becomes inactive/3 and returns to active/5. Repeat with a later edit to confirm conflict protection. Leave schedules inactive until tested.

### Customization
Only adapt registered tables and existing scalar fields after testing. Updates only: no inserts, deletes, messages or pre-install recovery. If receipt delivery fails, retry only Record operation with saved input; never repeat the provider update.

### Prepare the test
Set the development project origin and connection name. The manual trigger starts one disposable update. Keep credentials in n8n Header Auth, never in Set fields.

### Capture the real write
Read and validate the row revision, then call the capture transaction. The original values are captured before the update. A lost update response needs manual inspection.

### Deliver the saved receipt
Validate and record confirmed snapshots. If delivery fails, retry only Record operation with its saved input. Do not rerun capture to retry recording.
